questions.question: In a scale diagram, \(0.25\) inch represents \(500\) feet. How many inches represent \(1\) foot?

solution.exhibit_text: Set up a proportion: \(\dfrac{x}{1} = \dfrac{0.25}{500}\), so \(x = 0.0005\) in.

questions.question: A car is traveling \(45\) miles per hour, and \(1\) mile \(= 5{,}280\) feet. Which calculation gives the car's speed in **feet per second**?

solution.exhibit_text: Divide by \(3{,}600\) seconds/hour, then multiply by \(5{,}280\) feet/mile: \(\dfrac{45 \times 5{,}280}{3{,}600}\).

A survey asked students what pets they have. Based on the results, the following statements are all true:

• 18 students have guinea pigs.
